title: Signed subset inversion identity
statement: Let $U$ be a finite subset of a type with decidable equality, and let $g$ be a real-valued function on its finite subsets. Then $\sum_{S\subseteq U}\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}g(T)=g(U)$.
hypotheses_covered: $U$ is a finite subset of a type with decidable equality
$g$ maps finite subsets to real numbers
replaced: For a finite set $U$ and a real function $g$ on finite subsets, $\sum_{S\subseteq U}\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}g(T)=g(U)$.
